title: Northloop Payments Instant Payout Fee
content:
**Fee clause.** The fee of every instant payout is booked on the payments ledger on the day the instant payout is sent, as one instant payout fee entry that names the instant payout it is charged for. The instant payout fee is the payout amount times the instant fee rate, rounded to the cent, but never less than the plan's instant minimum fee. The instant fee rate is the plan's instant payout fee rate.

## Elements of the fee

| Element | Reading |
|---|---|
| Payout amount | the amount of the instant payout sent that day, as shown on the payments ledger |
| Instant fee rate | the payout plan's instant payout fee rate |
| Rounding | the payout amount times the rate is rounded to the cent |
| Floor | the rounded figure is never less than the plan's instant minimum fee |
| Booking | one fee entry, dated the day the instant payout is sent, naming that instant payout |

## Hypothetical worked examples

| Plan (rate, minimum fee) | Payout amount | Amount times rate | Rounded | Fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Payments Daily Plus (0.015, 0.50 USD) | 1234.00 USD | 18.51 | 18.51 | 18.51 USD |
| Payments Daily Plus (0.015, 0.50 USD) | 20.00 USD | 0.30 | 0.30 | 0.50 USD, the minimum fee |
| Payments Enterprise (0.01, 0.50 USD) | 2345.67 USD | 23.4567 | 23.46 | 23.46 USD |

In the second line the rounded figure of 0.30 USD is below the minimum fee of 0.50 USD, so the fee is 0.50 USD.
